remaining_differences.what: Workspace: the render retains the Folio Capture shell and a compact form rather than the reference’s large invoice entry header and bottom dock.
Document: seeded episodes may show a receipt or different invoice content from the reference.

deviations: The invoice widget uses the no-tabs and six-field fieldset traits to follow the reference layout.
report.notes: Fixed overlay, interruption, fault, and safety prompt positioning and compacted the long form. The site checker passed on the final files.

differences: Page structure: the design fills the window with a large document viewer, central form and right details table; the page places a small form and narrow receipt inside one broad, mostly empty workspace and omits the details table.
Application frame: the desktop title bar, File/Edit menus, large document summary, record navigation and zoom/fit/rotate toolbar are replaced by a small web navigation strip and breadcrumb row.
Bottom navigation: the design's full-width icon tabs and highlighted active tab are absent.
Task form: the design uses large labels and tall inputs in a full-height panel; the page uses much smaller text and compact controls in a floating bordered card.
Document viewer: the large bordered invoice with a visible scrollbar is replaced by a small receipt with tiny monospaced text and no viewer controls.
Visual treatment: the page retains cream backgrounds and serif text but loses the design's prominent typography, shaded panel headers, rounded borders and dense window-filling proportions.
frame_issues: Header, side-panel and notification settings all show the instruction in the same top header; the side panel and notification presentations are absent.
The hidden-instruction setting still shows a Submit control despite specifying no end control.
All four settings leave a large empty band between the episode header and application navigation, compressing the task into the lower portion of the screen.
